description: The file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application that interacts with the AccountManager API. It manages account updates, displays account information, and handles account selection UI interactions.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity that manages account updates, displays accounts, and handles user interactions for account selection.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up account update listeners, and configures UI elements and their event handlers.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Removes account update listener when activity is destroyed.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from account picker intent, showing appropriate Toast messages.
